speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Hello! Thanks for contacting Save the Children. How are you today?

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: I am doing just fine.  And yourself?

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Great! Thank you :) Do you have time for a short story

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: Always have time for stories.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: I frequently make trips to Uganda for our organization, and on my last visit saw a little boy names Jon about four years old without any clothes or shoes. I found his home; he was living in a ditch dugout without any electricity or running water. Our organization strives to help children like Jon by donating our time, money and resources.

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: That's a shame.  I am a parent myself and I know how important electricity, education, and clean water is to the well being of children.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: I am glad you understand the severity of his situation. There are so many more out there just like him! I try to donate 10% of my paycheck each month to send over to Ugandan children. I waste so much money on unnecessary things like coffee and donuts that I could be helping someone with!

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: Exactly.  Especially if you consider travesties like in Syria where the threat of violence is nearly a daily occurrence.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Yes Syria is just as bad. I wish we could help all of them, but all we can help is one at a time with the resources we have. Thanks so much for listening to my story!

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: I am well aware of the plight of children in developing countries and make it a point to donate where and when I can as well as support legislation and petitions that align with these values.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Thats wonderful. Could you spare some of your payment for this task to Save the Children today? We'd appreciate it immensely.

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: I'd be happy to donate 1 dollar.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: That is wonderful, thank so much.

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: I am always happy to help when it comes to children.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Have you seen our website,  URL ?

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: I have.  I have donated in the past.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Great. Jon will appreciate your gift so much!

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: It's no problem at all.

speaker: AX1M7QNB0C13S
text: Have a wonderful day! Thanks for contacting Save the Children.

speaker: A2VL807897JLT9
text: Sure thing!  Thank you.
